item.title: Park Chan-wook will lead the Cannes Film Festival jury, will be the 1st Korean in the role
item.description: Park Chan-wook, the Korean filmmaker of "Oldboy" and "No Other Choice," will head the jury at the 79th Cannes Film Festival, festival organizers announced Thursday.

item.title: What to know about the LA superintendent whose home was searched by FBI
item.description: Los Angeles schools chief Alberto Carvalho has developed a reputation for improving academics and graduation rates while leading two major U.S. districts.

item.title: The father of a US-based Hong Kong activist is sentenced to 8 months under national security law
item.description: A Hong Kong court has sentenced the father of a U.S.-based activist to eight months in prison in the first case brought against the relative of a pro-democracy activist wanted by the city's authorities under a national security law.

item.title: South Korea relaunches truth commission with focus on adoption fraud
item.description: South Korea has relaunched a fact-finding commission into its past human rights violations, with a key focus on the extensive fraud and malfeasance that corrupted the nation's historic foreign adoption program.

item.title: Jeff Galloway, who inspired people with his run-walk method, dies at 80
item.description: Jeff Galloway, a runner on the 1972 U.S. Olympic team, has died at age 80.

item.title: Amari Allen scores 23 points to lead No. 17 Alabama to 100-75 win over Mississippi State
item.description: Amari Allen scored 23 points, Latrell Wrightsell Jr. added 18, and No. 17 Alabama cruised to a 100-75 win over Mississippi State.

item.title: Stirtz scores 22, Folgueiras adds 20 to help Iowa beat Ohio State 74-57
item.description: Bennett Stirtz had 22 points on 8-of-11 shooting, Alvaro Folgueiras made 8 of 10 from the field and had a season-high 20 points and five assists, and Iowa beat Ohio State 74-57.

item.title: Graham Ike scores 19 points as No. 9 Gonzaga beats Portland 89-48 to clinch WCC crown
item.description: Graham Ike scored 19 points and matched a school record with seven steals as No. 9 Gonzaga routed Portland 89-48 to clinch its first West Coast Conference regular-season championship in three years.

item.title: Richmond scores 23 points to lead No. 20 Arkansas past Texas A&M 99-84
item.description: Billy Richmond III scored 23 points and No. 20 Arkansas took advantage of Texas A&M's miscues to beat the Aggies 99-84.

item.title: Colorado scores last 6 points, beats Kansas State 79-70
item.description: Colorado holds off a late Kansas State rally and wins 79-70 behind a big night from Isaiah Johnson.
